BiblicalUsage: Moses says, yea, He loved the people; all His saints are in Thy hand: and they sat down at Thy feet; every one shall receive of Thy words. The word is rare and its sense is uncertain, and the verse itself is the only place it appears. What is plain is the picture: a people sitting at God's feet, receiving His words.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the picture is worth more than the uncertain word: saints in His hand, sitting at His feet, and every one receiving His words — and that is where I want to be.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
